summary: Inspect's default trace path was outside the workspace and failed before scoring. Bind standard runtime data/cache locations to the isolated assurance directory, then rerun the same approved executor in trusted context as required after a sandbox failure.
changes: Phase-specific material fingerprints invalidate accepted phases and successors after code changes

regression: Focused controller suite is run by repair
M0-M3 revalidation scheduled because the supervisor and checking contract changed
findings: The sandbox failure is environment evidence, not failure of Inspect scoring
Old passed attempts are retained; stale results cannot suppress re-execution
